Meeke enters ERC’s Rali Ceredigion

Kris Meeke makes a guest appearance in the European Rally Championship at next month's event

Rallyevent tickets

Aug ‘26 21

Photography by Conor Edwards

Words by Luke Barry

Instaread

Kris Meeke will compete in the next round of the European Rally Championship, Rali Ceredigion, in a Toyota GR Yaris Rally2.

The Northern Irishman, who won the Intercontinental Rally Challenge title in 2009, will be co-driven by Noel O’Sullivan on the September 4-6 event which is also a round of the British Rally Championship.

“It’s a big thanks to all my sponsors who’ve helped me out again, especially KES and the local sponsors, and of course, thanks to everyone for supporting me and making it possible; it’s very exciting,” said Meeke.

“I’m hopeful, but I don’t underestimate the challenge with guys like Teemu Suninen, who’s been rallying every weekend… But I’m excited for the challenge and a big thanks to everyone that has made it possible. Let’s see what happens.”

Rallyevent tickets

Suninen currently leads the ERC standings by 25 points over Lancia driver Andrea Mabellini.

Meeke last drove a Rally2 car at Portugal’s Rali da Madeira where a mistake cost him victory. He drove a Toyota at the Donegal International Rally in June, and was leading the event ahead of M-Sport Rally1 pilot Josh McErlean before it was stopped due to a spectator fatality.

Meeke’s last event in the UK was the 2023 Roger Albert Clark Rally where the engine in his Ford Escort Mk2 expired.
